text: Programs in education can be traced back to the year 1902, when BNU was established. With a long history and substantial strength, the discipline of education in the Faculty of Education is a characteristic discipline, which BNU attaches great importance to. The discipline of education in this School is the best in China and is also the earliest institution for authorization of first level discipline in education. At present, the Faculty of Education provides four undergraduate programs with over 10 international students studying there.
